PHIT PHEST is a curated weekend of indie improv at PHIT, featuring standout teams and special guests from Philadelphia and beyond. Each night brings a different lineup of performers, styles, and surprises — all celebrating bold, playful, live improv.

SATURDAY AUG 1

Tickets

A quick note to help you choose your ticket:

$30 - Advocate Ticket
General admission seating

Maybe your budget has a little more room right now, so paying a little more for a ticket wouldn’t mean saying no to something else this month. Choosing this tier helps support the real cost of producing PHEST—venue, operations, guest artist pay, and event staff support.

PHIT is a training center committed to developing performers, building skills, and creating opportunities to share excellent work with an audience. Thanks for helping support that work.


$15 - Team Player Ticket
General admission seating

Maybe you're a student, a senior, in between gigs, freelancing, or supporting others. Maybe you’re doing okay now, but a higher ticket would mean saying no to something else this month. Choosing this tier means you’re making space for yourself—and helping us stay connected to the full range of folks in our city. That’s the spirit of a true team player. This ticket helps keep our shows welcoming and within reach for more people. If $15 works for your budget, we’re so glad you’re here.


Optional Donation


At checkout, you’ll see an option to “Add a Donation.” This contribution is not tax-deductible, since PHIT is a for-profit company, but it does help in real ways: keeping tickets more affordable and helping us pay performers and staff fairly.

If you’re in a position to add a little extra, thank you. We’re genuinely grateful.

name: The Reome Ring: Pittsburgh Edition
description:
The Reome Ring is a monthly show featuring Chicago's top performers creating improv chaos at the whim of a bell. Every month offers a new array of the city's top-notch improvisers, creating a never before, never after cast lead by Kevin Reome. Now Kevin brings his bells and meets some of Pittsburgh's finest improvisers for a once in a lifetime show. Don't miss it! Cast list subject to change.

Featuring: Paul Matttingly, Aaron Crutchfield, Scott Pettis, Sarah McChesney, Justin Zell, and Cynthia Dallas.

With Special Guests, BABY SCOTT BACK: Rachael Gunning, Nick Killen, Hannah Zidansek and Adam Zweber.

Saturday, August 15th @ 730pm.

Pay-what-you-will tickets.

Kevin Reome has been teaching improv for over 20 years at The Second City Training Center in Chicago. He is a founding member of the long-form improv team “Inside Vladimir” at iO Chicago and also performed with the Upright Citizens Brigade there.
Improv training both, corporate and theater, has taken Reome to the University of Michigan, Detroit, Atlanta, Cincinnati, San Diego, Houston, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Denver, Mexico City and many others including the Western Michigan University football team and the Detroit Tigers. In 2014 he taught in Osaka, Japan for The Second City.

He wrote and starred in various Chicago shows such as The Eulogist, Rahm Zombie, The Reome Awards of Chicago to Benefits Alzheimer’s Research, Lightfoot Loose and currently hosts and plays monthly in The Reome Ring, with a rotating assortment of all-star Chicago improvisers. Check out Reome as a guest on podcasts, Improv4humans, Improv Nerd with Jimmy Carrane and A.D.D. with Dave Razowsky.

He has appeared on the ABC 7 talk show Windy City Live as well as Fox Chicago, NBC5 Chicago, WBBM Newsradio and WLS Talk Radio. In 2022 he gave the TedTalk “What’s My Motivation?” Kevin has a B.A. in English and a teaching degree from Western Michigan University.

Check out the WORKSHOPS he is teaching on Sunday, August 16th.
